evidence.reason: qemu_command interpolates the resolved run path directly into comma-delimited -drive option strings. If the state directory contains a comma (for example `probe,local`), QEMU parses the comma as an option delimiter and the launch fails even though preparation created the overlay and seed files. QEMU requires literal commas in option values to be doubled; escaping the path values or rejecting comma-containing paths before preparation is a routine correctness repair.
